title: Teaching Teddy Hale
summary: Green says he taught Teddy Hale, one of Ted Lewis's shadows, how to tap while travelling with Chuck and Chuckles.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: So you're saying that you had a certain philosophy about what you were doing.
And you tried to transcend that to other dancers at the Hoofers Club?
How were they relating to tap dance? What was their connection?

Well, there's a for instance. You take like Teddy Hale. He used to be the shadow of -- one of the shadows of Ted Lewis, that made that song famous about me and my shadow walking up the avenue. Teddy Hale was one of his shadows. But after they grow, become a certain age, Mr. Ted Lewis didn't have -- he'd get a new shadow, however that's possible. Now, I had a chance to teach Ted Hale how to tap dance. See? And that's where I used to go with him. Until I thought that he remembered everything that he was learning.
